title: Public activity feed
description: Public activity feed for the blowhorn.ai hero social proof card. Carries Layer5 Cloud user ids, never emails or post content. Served by Layer5 Cloud at GET /api/public/activity-feed; this file is the single contract. Hyphens never em dashes.

sample.description: True when the payload is example data, not a live feed.

platform.description: Integration id. Supported platforms only, matching data/integrations.json.

displayName.description: The person's public username on their Layer5 Cloud profile, never their real name. Present only for public profiles, alongside avatarUrl, organizationName and publicProfileUrl. Filled in by Layer5 Cloud when the feed is read; the Blowhorn engine does not send it.

avatarUrl.description: Present only for public profiles, alongside displayName, organizationName and publicProfileUrl. Filled in by Layer5 Cloud when the feed is read; the Blowhorn engine does not send it.

organizationName.description: Present only for public profiles, alongside displayName, avatarUrl and publicProfileUrl. Filled in by Layer5 Cloud when the feed is read; the Blowhorn engine does not send it.

publicProfileUrl.description: Present only for public profiles, alongside displayName, avatarUrl and organizationName. Filled in by Layer5 Cloud when the feed is read; the Blowhorn engine does not send it.
